definitions.explanation: A military plane built to drop bombs on targets on the ground or at sea. In Japan the word recalls above all the American B-29s that bombed Japanese cities in 1944–45.

examples.japanese: {爆撃機|ばくげきき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}んで→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧きた。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{爆撃機|ばくげきき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えている→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather still remembers the sound of the bombers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末期|まっき}→末期：13032_makki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{爆撃機|ばくげきき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{襲|おそ}った→襲う：01915_osou⟧。
examples.english: Near the end of the war, large bombers attacked the cities almost every night.

notes:
⟦{爆撃|ばくげき}→爆撃：13584_bakugeki⟧ (bombing) + ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (aircraft). ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ forms the names of many aircraft types: ⟦{戦闘機|せんとうき}→戦闘機：23287_sentouki⟧ (fighter), ⟦{旅客機|りょかくき}→旅客機：17838_ryokakuki⟧ (airliner), {輸送機|ゆそうき} (transport plane).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {爆撃機|ばくげきき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛来|ひらい}→飛来：31692_hirai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: bombers fly in
- {戦略爆撃機|せんりゃくばくげきき}: strategic bomber
- {爆撃機|ばくげきき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{編隊|へんたい}: a formation of bombers
